structured.answer: If my money just sits in the עו"ש it shrinks: the page says 10,000 ₪ turns into 8,203 ₪ "בכסף של היום" after 10 years, 1,797 less, so my 30,000 is losing value too. A קרן כספית would keep it at about 10,779, so I'd move it out of the עו"ש. I'm fairly sure, though I never saw the figure for my own 30,000.

stuck.why: It sits on 10,000 ₪, not my 30,000. On these screens I couldn't put my own amount in, so I got the answer for someone else's money

stuck.where: Second calculator 'מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן' (screens 3-4)
stuck.why: A big 62,681 ₪ with 'מחושב'. For a second I thought money in the עו"ש grows to 62k. Then I saw it's 10,000 plus 500 a month, 70,000 put in. So it's less than what went in, but the big number pulls the eye the wrong way
The light blue line is בעו"ש and the yellow is קרן כספית. The 2,576 'המחיר של להשאיר' sits in a brown box in the middle and I had to go back to the legend to match it

findings.what: The second calculator puts a huge 62,681 ₪ right under the עו"ש topic. It looks like growth, but it's actually less than the 70,000 put in. Easy to read wrong
Calculator starts at 10,000, not my amount. I'd have to type my own number, and on these screens I couldn't
The 2,576 'המחיר של להשאיר' sits apart from the coloured area it belongs to. I had to look back and forth to the legend
Code tags like BANK-17 and TXI OQ11 in the middle of sentences break up the reading and mean nothing to me
'הצגת החוקים והכללים' is repeated next to every heading, so it's just noise
Long tax and deposit insurance text with a red box. It's scary and I didn't come for it
